page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no marginal notes. Running head at top with page number 100 at left. Lettered items a, b, c are running text paragraphs; italic headings and lines of verse-like list in the column.

main_text.head: Eorum qui secudum naturam dormiuerunt.
main_text.p: Trium horum rationes ex antecedentibus maximè patent.
main_text.head: Eorum qui immoderatè vigilarunt ob causam aliquam,
main_text.p: a. Tenues & aliquando albissimæ profluüt aut ob bilis regressum ad cerebrum, aut ob insaniæ speciem.
b. Versicolores, nempe interdum albæ, interdū croceæ,& aureæ,ac oleaceæ,& nigræ, secundū cau sæ mutantis proprietatem.
c. Contentis extraneis magis, nempe inæqualibus & maximè confusis, coctione non tam facile procedente,si aut aliqua intemperatura excesserit, aut usquequaq; homo uigilauerit.
main_text.head: Multum comedentium, & non coquentium,

page.notes: Running head and headings set in italic; the marginal words at right edge are show-through and were omitted. Short italic lines (Spiceæ, Substantia, etc.) are treated as list lines. The final word "Hæc" is a catchword-like closing word at right, transcribed as a paragraph.
